mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 69 degrees near Verona City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon.

City officials remind us that road surface treatment begins August 4 on Lincoln Street, so expect parking restrictions. Also, if you are looking to save water, you can apply for a 100 dollar rebate for installing a high-efficiency toilet.

Today is packed with activities including the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School and the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree at Seven Acre Dairy Co. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on August 3 or trivia nights starting August 4.
Regarding local activity, on July 25, a 29-year-old woman was arrested for O W I, which marks a reminder to always drive safely.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano and the restaurant is open until 10:30 PM. For some extra fun today, you can find the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park between 1:30 PM and 3:15 PM.
